home.faq.included.answer: TanStack Start and Router provide file-based routing and server rendering. The template also includes TanStack Query, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, reusable UI components, three languages, theme switching, and MDX content pages.
home.faq.included.question: What does the template include?
home.faq.languages.answer: Edit messages/en.json, messages/ja.json, and messages/zh-cn.json, keeping the keys consistent. Run pnpm i18n:generate to compile the messages. Localized page content lives in content/pages; do not edit generated Paraglide files.
home.faq.languages.question: Where do I change the translated text?
home.faq.pages.answer: Add a route file under src/routes and compose your page from components. The route tree is generated automatically. For an informational MDX page, add content under content/pages and use the existing static-page route pattern.
home.faq.pages.question: How do I add a page?
home.faq.styling.answer: Use Tailwind utilities in components and adjust the light and dark design tokens in src/styles.css. Set VITE_DEFAULT_THEME to light, dark, or system to choose the initial theme; a saved visitor preference takes priority.
home.faq.styling.question: How do I customize the styles and themes?
